Siddhanta Knowledge Foundation (Siddhanta) is part of the Siddhanta Group with a vision to provide Bharatiya intellectual capital to the global community. The organization works towards reviving, nurturing, and developing Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) through education, research, and technology-enabled platforms.

Siddhanta is honored to partner with the Ministry of Education, Government of India, to re-contextualize and contemporize India’s rich traditional knowledge corpus for modern audiences. The organization collaborates with premier Indian institutions on focused research projects rooted in primary texts and manuscripts, with the objective of creating transdisciplinary learning resources, courses, and applications.

Siddhanta is developing over 100 cutting-edge IKS-based courses for schools, colleges, and universities across disciplines such as Science, Technology, Engineering, Management, Law, Medicine, Arts, and Humanities. In addition, it creates educational materials including rhymes, e-games, animation serials, textbooks, and courses for learners of all age groups.

Its initiatives also include publishing works by young authors in Indian languages including Sanskrit, translating important Indic texts, digitizing rare and ancient manuscripts, and providing platforms for scholarly knowledge exchange. For over 30 years, Siddhanta’s founders have been actively involved in protecting and promoting Bharatiya cultural heritage through Parampara, a sister organization focused on the welfare of women and children.
